sources.officialityEvidence: PICA is Jamaica's immigration authority and its live page publishes the national entry-visa table. The table itself says it was last updated 19 July 2023 and does not name Vatican City/Holy See or the Republic of the Congo, so it cannot establish either current ordinary-passport rule by omission.

sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government of Jamaica MFAFT page describes advance consular and port-of-entry issuance generally, but names no Vatican City/Holy See or Republic of the Congo nationality result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of certain countries are able to obtain their visas at the port of entry.

unresolved.reason: No current Jamaican primary source directly maps a Vatican City/Holy See ordinary passport to a short-visitor route. PICA's live schedule omits it and is dated 2023; the MFAFT page is general. Do not infer an advance visa from omission or diplomatic relations.

No current Jamaican or Republic of the Congo primary source directly maps an ordinary Republic of the Congo passport to a Jamaican short-visitor issuance route. PICA's live schedule does not name this exact state and no complement is inferred.
